Can you detail for which sensors you are expecting statistics? Not all integrations are adapted to it and not all sensors are valid for statistics.
that will be the current_real_power, so it will possible to see the load over time.

I solve it with a template sensor and integration integration:

```
- platform: template
  sensors:
    living_room_ups_power:
      friendly_name: "Living Room UPS Power"
      icon_template: 'mdi:lightning-bolt'
      unit_of_measurement: "W"
      device_class: power
      value_template: >
        {{ states('sensor.living_room_ups_nominal_real_power') | float * states('sensor.living_room_ups_load') | float / 100 - 
           states('sensor.living_room_tv_power') | float 
        }}
- platform: integration
  source: sensor.living_room_ups_power
  name: Living Room UPS Energy Total
  unit_prefix: k
  round: 2
```
